场 01 · 内 · 车里 · 夜

**RHETT**
Your call. Right is home, left is the long way, and the long way has a diner that stays open until four.
你定。

**THEO**
You planned the diner.
你连餐馆都想好了。

**RHETT**
I planned two diners. One of them closed in March, so I planned a third one on the way back.
我想了两家。一家三月关了。
